notesHint: Identify the primary source page first; explain what each supporting page adds to it.
description_en: A large labelled lead page anchors two to four supporting sources; scrolling assembles the relationship and then holds it.
description_ko: 라벨을 붙인 핵심 자료 한 장을 중심에 두고, 뒷받침하는 세네 장 자료를 스크롤로 모아 관계를 한 프레임에 고정합니다.
responsive: Keep the lead page dominant. On mobile, stack it above a two-column support grid so every label stays visible.
reducedMotion: Show all pages at once: a full-width lead source followed by a labelled two-column support grid.
purpose: 핵심 출처와 보조 자료의 관계를 한 화면에서 확인한다.

exampleCopy.title: 오래 쓰고 쉽게 고치는 마감
lines: 재생 목재 · 저휘도 확산 조명 · 교체형 흡음 패널 · 손때가 남는 패브릭

sceneContract.fit: A primary document page plus up to four genuinely supporting pages, each with a concise label.
sceneContract.unfit: Unrelated images, more than five pages, or claims that need every page to be readable at once.
sceneContract.requiredInputs: Three to five source images. Provide assets.imageAlt for direct page/figure labels; copy.lines[0] states the relationship.
sceneContract.scrollBeatSemantics: The source page arrives first and remains dominant as supporting pages gather into a labelled evidence set.
sceneContract.stableHold: At the held frame the primary page is large, all support labels remain visible, and the claim line is present.
sceneContract.projectorTypeCriteria: The primary page uses at least 42vw width on desktop; readable page labels accompany every source.
sceneContract.labelCriteria: Every image must have a truthful, specific asset alt label. The lead/support relation must be stated in the copy.
sceneContract.mobile: The primary page spans the first row above a two-column support grid. Every image label and the claim remain visible.
sceneContract.reducedMotion: Show the lead page in a full-width row and every labelled support page in a static grid.
sceneContract.exampleContent: One primary research excerpt with three labelled method/measurement/result figures.
sceneContract.unsupportedReason: Not suitable for a stack of decorative thumbnails or dense source documents that need close reading.
sceneContract.nextImplementation: Keep page count to five and verify lead/support labels in desktop, mobile, and reduced-motion browser captures.
sceneContract.failureFallback: 자료 간 지지 관계가 명확하지 않으면 작은 문서 썸네일을 쌓지 말고 핵심 원문 하나를 크게 보여준다.
sceneContract.reviewNote: 선택 후보입니다. 대표 장면의 1440×900·1920×1080·390px·모션 감소 상태와 스크롤 역방향을 독립 검수하기 전에는 완성 템플릿으로 간주하지 않습니다.
